bio: Co-founder @RadSightMY. On-premise vision-language models for chest CT & X-ray triage across Malaysian district hospitals.
discovered_via: SEG-04: Regional AI & Robotics Lab Researchers

recent_posts.text: District hospitals rarely have cloud connectivity for DICOM uploads or big GPU budgets. Our 4-bit quantized MedVLM runs locally in <3.8GB VRAM and flags critical pneumothorax cases in 1.4 seconds with 98.1% sensitivity across 14,000 retrospective scans.
